SELECT o.fulfilment_type, date_trunc('month', CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE)) om, date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) sm, date_diff('day', CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE), f.sale_date) dd, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) orders, sum(f.net_amount) net

WITH web AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount,
         (o.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS is_member, (f.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS line_member,
         COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0) AS refund
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) r ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period,
       round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN is_member THEN net_amount END) / sum(net_amount), 2) AS member_share_pct,
       round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN line_member THEN net_amount END) / sum(net_amount), 2) AS chk_line_level_pct,
       round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN is_member THEN net_amount - refund END) / sum(net_amount - refund), 2) AS chk_net_of_returns_pct,
       round(sum(net_amount),2) AS chk_web_net, count(*) AS chk_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS chk_distinct
FROM web GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2
